body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Pyramat presented a portable sound chair for gamers during CES 2007. In connection with game consoles, it helps to increase your excitement. Especially, by adopting its exclusive ''ARX'' technology it enables users to experience the vibration in different intensity. For example, you can tell the difference between a cannon and a rifle when watching a war movie.
